statement: Per-task, per-call credentials will be the default in the quickstart of at least one of the three most-starred open-source agent frameworks.
observable: Quickstart code of the three most-starred open-source agent frameworks on the review date
wrong_if: 0 of the three issue a per-task or per-call credential in the default quickstart
source: repository READMEs and quickstarts read on the review date

statement: No defence that works inside the model will be shown, by authors who did not build it, to hold at zero attack success against an adaptive attacker on three or more models.
observable: Published evaluations of model-level injection defences by independent authors
wrong_if: one such independent paper reports 0 percent adaptive attack success on three or more models
source: arXiv search for independent adaptive-attack evaluations, read on the review date

statement: At least one model-level injection defence published after 2026-11-15 will be reported broken by an adaptive attack, at above 50 percent success, within six months of its publication.
observable: Papers reporting adaptive attacks on newly published defences
wrong_if: no defence published in the window is reported above 50 percent adaptive success within six months
source: arXiv search, read on the review date

statement: The Model Context Protocol specification will change its authorization requirements at least once between 2026-11-15 and the review date.
observable: The authorization sections of the specification's changelog
wrong_if: the changelog shows no authorization-related change in the window
source: the specification repository's changelog read on the review date

statement: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, the model behind most live labs in this book, will be listed as deprecated or retired by its vendor.
observable: The vendor's published model deprecation page
wrong_if: the model is not listed as deprecated or retired on the review date
source: vendor deprecation page read on the review date

statement: A public incident report will attribute a money loss of at least 100,000 US dollars to an LLM agent acting on injected instructions.
observable: Public incident reports, court filings and regulator statements
wrong_if: no such public report exists on the review date
source: web search and incident databases on the review date

statement: At least half of the live-model labs in this book, re-run on the then-current default models, will fall outside the intervals printed in the chapters.
observable: Re-runs of ten live labs chosen at random from the repository
wrong_if: fewer than 5 of 10 re-run labs fall outside their printed intervals
source: re-run by the author or a contributor; logs committed to the repository

statement: The 522 no-model tests of the repository will need at least 10 edits because of dependency upgrades alone.
observable: Commits between 2026-11-15 and the review date that change test files and mention a dependency
wrong_if: fewer than 10 test edits in the window are caused by a dependency upgrade

statement: At least one agent vendor will publish a signed control bundle that includes a claim of operating evidence over a stated period.
observable: Vendor trust pages and security documentation
wrong_if: no vendor publishes such a bundle by the review date
source: vendor documentation read on the review date

statement: A publicly documented case will show an approval screen that displayed a summary produced by the model being the point of failure in a loss.
observable: Public incident reports naming the approval step
wrong_if: no public report names an approval step that relied on a model summary
source: web search on the review date
